items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I always listened to them. ... I used to marvel at him. I used to say, 'I wish I could play like that.'

ctx.x: Now, when you started, you really didn't start by listening to records and picking up on somebody originally, did you?
Well, no. No more than Louis Armstrong and Roy Eldridge. I always listened to them.
But you were listening to them as soloists.
